restoration_note: This teaching describes the natural man as molded out of the Watchers' fallen residue (bones of their begotten children pressed into the proprium), and the inward correspondence — Sin rooted in the body until the Mind of Light is rooted there as a tree. Most gaps are short and tightly constrained by Manichaean cosmological formulae (Pillar of Glory, helpers of Pherrokatochos bearing up burdens, four angels binding Egregoroi, Omophoros' shoulders, watch-station of the mind, ⲭⲱⲗⲭ-fashioning of cosmic gods like trees in their boundary). I confirmed nearly all editor restorations as fitting both spiritual register and Coptic morphology. Several medium lacunae (especially {9}, {10}, {22}, {27}, {28}) lack sufficient trace and parallel to constrain a fill responsibly and are left unrestorable.

restorations.basis: Editor's completion of ⲫⲉⲣⲣⲟⲕⲁⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ across line break is correct: the chapter heading ends with the Holder, who reappears as ⲡⲫⲉⲣⲣⲟⲕⲁⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ in the next line.
The Pillar of Glory is the path of ascent (lexicon); ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'came forth upward' fits the rising-column image. ~3-4 chars with overstroke.
Plural article before ⲃⲟⲏⲑⲟⲥ — the helpers (plural) of the Holder bearing up the burdens, standard formula.
ⲍⲁ ⲛⲍⲣⲏϣⲉ 'under the burdens' is the fixed Manichaean formula for what the Pillar/Omophoros/Pherrokatochos bear.
Completes ⲉⲓⲣⲏⲅⲟⲣⲟⲥ across line break (ⲛⲉⲓⲣⲏⲅⲟ|ⲣⲟⲥ).
ⲁⲩⲃⲱⲧⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they expelled' — perfect prefix; refers to expelling the Watchers' giant-sons from the earth.
Standard causal discourse marker ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ opening the next pericope.
Perfect prefix ⲁⲩ + ⲭⲡⲟ 'begot' — the abortions begot Adam and Eve.
ⲉⲧⲁϩϣⲱⲡⲉ 'which arose,' parallel to the same construction at l.160.

5 chars with partial 'ⲃⲉ ⲍ' admit no formula or parallel that yields a constrained fill; the verb governing 'the prayer of the Five Sons' (saw / heard / answered) cannot be uniquely determined from the trace.
9-char lacuna ending in -ⲧⲥ with no parallel formula; cannot fix the noun/verb that takes a feminine-singular suffix here.
ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̄ⲁⲇⲁⲙ 'the Mind of Adam' is the standard Manichaean technical phrase for the awakening; ⲙ̄ⲡ continues the genitive across the line break.
ⲡⲧⲏⲩ 'wind' — parallel triad wind/water/fire (l.162).
ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'set, establish' — Jesus sets the way for their upward-going.
ⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ 'once again' — fixed Coptic discourse doublet introducing a new pericope.
ⲃⲱϣ 'wither/dry' completes the verb describing the bone of the lower Omophoros, then ⲛ̄ⲛⲧⲱⲟⲥ 'the shoulders.'
ⲉⲧⲙ̄ⲭⲓ ⲛ̄ⲕⲱ 'have not received rest' — the lower shoulders of the Omophoros are restless. ⲭⲓ (Lyc for ϫⲓ) fits 2-3 chars with overstroke.
ⲛ̄ⲉⲩⲥⲁ 'for an hour/moment' — parallel to l.163 (Jesus took up a watch ⲛⲉⲩⲥⲁ).
ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that' demonstrative completing 'that place'; ⲁ- is the directional preposition before the next infinitive.
Editor's ⲥⲱⲣⲟ̄ for 'comfort/console' fits the syntactic slot; the Lord descends to comfort the lower shoulders.
ⲧⲁⲭⲣⲟ (=ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ) 'strengthen' — Jesus strengthens the lower shoulders of the Omophoros.
ⲁϩⲉⲓ infinitive 'to come'; the upward-coming of the shoulders.
2-char gap with scribal correction mark †; cannot reliably reconstruct what the corrector wrote before -ⲙⲧⲁⲛ.
ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ 'the Zone' — the cosmic girdle (lexicon).
ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ relative converter introducing the great Gods who watch over the watches.
ⲣ̄ⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'watch over' — completes the verb of the great Gods watching over the Zone-watches.
4-char connective introducing 'weariness occurred' in the next clause; ⲧⲟⲧⲉ 'then' fits length and discourse function.
10-char lacuna with traces ⲡ...ⲱⲛ... admits multiple noun candidates (ⲡⲡⲱⲛⲉ, ⲡⲱⲛϩ̄ + modifier, ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ); none uniquely constrained.
3-char gap ending in ⲛ̄ before ⲥⲏⲧⲟⲩ; verb cannot be uniquely fixed.
ⲉⲫⲃⲓⲟ (=ⲑⲃⲃⲓⲟ) 'humility' — humbling of the powers of enmity, formulaic.
ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϩⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲥⲏⲧ 'according to his purpose of heart' — fixed collocation.
ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'watching-place / watch-station' (lexicon ⲡⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ); parallel to l.187.
Final ⲉ completes the verb form (ⲛⲉⲥⲥⲉ 'casts/throws') for Sin's repeated disturbance in the body.
ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth, outwardly' — discernment and wise-knowledge revealed outwardly to the good ones.
ⲉⲧⲥⲙⲁⲁⲛⲧ 'which is established' — Lyc relative converter ⲉϩ-/ⲉⲧ-.
ⲁ-ⲧⲟⲩ-ϯ purposive 'that they may give' the verdict of cutting against enmity.
ⲥⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲥⲁⲧⲉ 'with fire' — preposition + indefinite for the executing fire.
4-char directional after ⲟ̄ⲁⲡⲟⲩ 'reckon them' — ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'out, away' is the standard adverbial used for this verb of judging-out.
4-char trace ending '...ⲙⲉ' before ⲁⲩⲣ̄ϣⲁⲣⲡ; ⲛⲁⲙⲉ 'truly' fits as discourse adverb opening the affirmation that 'they were first to stand in a hidden goodness.'
ϩⲁⲡⲣⲁ 'concerning the matter of' — chapter-question formula introducing the disciple's added question about how the Mind of Light enters the body.
ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the Mind of Light' — the lexicon's fixed phrase, with genitive ⲛ̄.
Continues ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲩⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲙⲁ 'this small body' across line break.
5-char gap ending in ⲛ at start of clause about gods being great strong ones; copular construction admits multiple realizations (ⲛⲉⲩⲱⲛ / ⲍⲉⲛⲛ̄ / etc.) without trace constraint.
Editor's ϩⲛ̄- as plural indefinite-attributive marker before ⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'great' fits 'they are some great strong ones.'
3pl copula ⲛⲉ in nominal sentence 'they are great strong ones.'
Completes ϩⲫⲗⲓⲃⲉ (Greek θλίβειν 'oppress, afflict') across line break.
ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧϩⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧϥ̄ 'in this place in which he stands fast' — locative formula matching the trees-rooted-in-their-place image.
Initial letter of ⲭⲱⲗⲭ 'fashion, prepare' — repeated at l.203.

Lexeme uncertain; the parallel ⲡⲉϩ-ⲁⲙⲁⲓ̈ⲏⲏⲥ at l.203 (3sg.m possessor) shows this is a possessable noun. Tree-image and lexicon's 'tree rooted in its place' suggest 'support/foundation' (cf. ⲁⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'grasp, hold').
ⲡⲟⲩⲉ 'each one' — completing the distributive 'each one of them.'
Same lexeme as l.202 with 3sg.m possessor — 'his support/foundation' with which each cosmic god is fashioned in place.
Feminine article ⲧ for ⲧⲟ̄ⲁⲧ 'the boundary.'
ⲧⲟ̄ⲁⲧ likely Lycopolitan reflex of ⲧⲱϣ 'boundary, ordained measure'; matches the trees-rooted-in-their-boundary image.
